correctness.rationale: The product covariogram is exact. Reflection orders orientations; a half-angle variable reduces the axis-competitor threshold to a strictly unimodal rational function and one quartic root. The angular stationary equation has one minimum and one maximum branch because its cubic derivative numerator is strictly increasing. The global comparison, feasibility, endpoint classification, and explicit positive kink follow analytically. The included checker independently tested 285 finite cases, but finite trials are not the proof.

value.rationale: The unequal-rectangle covariogram at fixed Euclidean displacement has a nontrivial discontinuous optimizer transition, unique quartic-derived threshold, smoothly varying post-transition orientation and strictly positive derivative kink.
